svg.title: Potbot U00 roadmap inventory
svg.desc: Plan 1.0 has 153 steps and Plan 1.1 has 204. Architecture 1.1 has 35 gates. Independent programme namespaces feed a source-hashed inventory with drift checks. A separately authored review closes U00; runtime qualification remains separate.

g.text: Potbot U00 · preserve requirements before extending the runtime
Generated contract diagram · source coverage and runtime acceptance have separate evidence
Tool, memory, modernization, skills, UI and Syn
Repeated labels retain their source namespace
Source hashes + exact stage locators + U owners
Narrative coverage · code/test scope · PRs/issues · CI heads · blockers
U00-A audit complete → U01-A durable effect and crash recovery
Runtime gates remain open · refresh cannot manufacture a review
